text:
Rafael (CSM): Pelari Labs requested a 3-week enablement series: onboarding -> prompts lab -> production checklist. They want hands-on office hours + recordings. Possible start week of May 5. Who can lead each session? Also flagging a renewal touchpoint; onboarding progress is behind schedule.
Aisha (Enablement): I can run the onboarding + office hours. Suggest 90-min sessions: 45m walkthrough + 45m lab. Will prepare slides and a short pre-work survey. Do we have dates?
Jon (SE): I'll own the prompts lab (session 2). Quick Q: Pelari is on Dedicated right? Need to cover autoscale, batching, and routing fallback.
Mei (Solutions): Confirmed: Pelari is on Dedicated (reserved). Recommend we include latency/cost knobs + KV cache walkthrough. They need a staging dataset and temporary API key.
Rafael (CSM): Pelari's PM confirmed availability: May 6, May 13, May 20 — afternoons PST. I'll request staging data and temp creds today.
Aisha (Enablement): Draft agendas:
- Week 1 (May 6): Platform intro, account map, onboarding checklist, quickstarts (90m)
- Week 2 (May 13): Prompts lab + evals, failure modes, metrics to track (90m)
- Week 3 (May 20): Production bakeoff: routing, batching, quantization, rollout strategy (90m)
Jon (SE): Calendar invite snippet (copy into invite):
```
Pelari Enablement — Week 2: Prompts Lab
Host: Jon (SE), Aisha (Enablement)
Pre-work: short survey + sample prompts
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/placeholder
Recording: will be saved to shared bucket
```
CalendarBot: Provisional recurring series created: https://calendar.redwood.com/series/xyz123 — will update when invites are sent.
Rafael (CSM): Can someone own recordings + follow-up playbook? We should attach an enablement playbook to the renewal workspace. Marking renewal risk as 'monitoring' until follow-up.
Mei (Solutions): I'll take week 3 recordings + create the follow-up playbook and a short evaluation prompt set. Will upload to s3://redwood-pelari/enablement/.
Aisha (Enablement): I will run the live office hours and publish recordings to the bucket. Please grant me staging access: `redwoodctl grant access --customer pelari --env staging`.
Jon (SE): Quick tech prereq checklist to include in invites: 1) staging creds 2) sample token usage 3) allowed IPs for Dedicated. Config snippet for Dedicated access:
```
# grant temporary staging access
redwoodctl grant --customer pelari --env staging --role reader --expires 7d
```
Rafael (CSM): Perfect — I'll send the invites today (May 6/13/20 afternoons PST) and add calendar owners. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
